descriptions: You can download a trial version of this app to try it for 30 minutes for free.
You won’t be charged anything when this free trial ends. You can’t make in-app purchases or use add-on content during this free trial, but you’ll keep any achievements you earn.

display_long_description:
Horror Simulator is a scary multiplayer social VR game where horror chases, lethal puzzles and teamwork collide. Drop into haunted rooms, outsmart demons in the dark, and team up with your friends to survive the night!
                                                                                          
[media]
# 🏆 A Top-Rated Horror Experience

Winner of the **2024 Golden Gyro Award** for "**Most Anticipated VR Game**" and a **Meta Quest New Release** standout. Step into Horror Simulator, join our legendary community, and see why it maintains a stellar **4.7-star rating**.

**discord.gg/hsvr**

# 👻Multiplayer Mayhem
Team up with up to **3 other players** in online co-op, or hang out in **10-player lobbies**. You can choose to play in random public serves or host your own private servers. 

# 👻3 Haunted Maps to Explore
- **BigRoom**
- **HighSchool**
- **OldFactory**
[media]

# 👻Mode UPDATES
- **Easy and Crazy Mode**: Chill in Easy Mode, or jump into Crazy for faster chases! 
- **🔥New! HELL MODE**: Pray you don't hear them nearby-because they've already heard you.
# 👻Hunt the Dead
- **Explore Haunted Rooms**: Don't just watch-**hunt**. Track whisper. breach cursed rooms, hunt demons!
[media]
# 👻Solve Puzzles, Fight Demons
- **Tools & Power-ups**: Dynamic demons hunts—use exorcism equipments like holy water, Bibles, or voice changers to fight back!
[media]
# 👻Level Up
- **Customize Looks**: Unlock animal masks, skins and angel avatars...Choose from many different types
[media]
